description: Whether a Solana or EVM address is on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list's published crypto addresses, before an agent sends funds to it: the lists it matched, how many addresses each holds and when the list was fetched (refreshed daily). Adds Chainalysis's sanctions screening when the server has a key. Informational, not a compliance decision: an address that isn't listed can still belong to a sanctioned party. Fails (and is not charged) if the list is unavailable. Costs $0.001 USDC per call.
name: address_screen
title: Sanctions address screen
